title: Fix it from the message
hints: Press Run and read what comes after the word got. It names the kind of error and the name Python does not know.
A `NameError` means a name that nothing points at. Compare the name in the message with the names on line 1, letter by letter.
Line 2 says `cuont`. Line 1 calls the input `count`.
explain: The reference changes `cuont` to `count` on line 2. Nothing points at the name `cuont`, so Python stops with a `NameError` each time line 2 runs. With the spelling fixed, the function returns `price * count`.
